title: CDIF Provenance profile
description: NOT merely prov:wasGeneratedBy present — a minimal prov:Activity with prov:used is already declared in cdifCore. The cdifProv class is marked by a dual-typed prov:Activity + schema:Action with at least one of schema:instrument, schema:object or schema:actionProcess, the cdifProvActivity required one-of. The validity gate is the cdifProvActivity content shapes.
